name: Weather favourite bid
description: Rests a post-only bid (no maker fee on weather) on the highest-priced bracket of each KXHIGH city-day, 12-34 h before the close, and holds to settlement. Early in the day the bracket ladder is too wide: the favourite wins more often than its mid implies.
hypothesis: Dev trades at fixed hours before close (10 cities, 335 days): the favourite bracket's outcome rate beats its mid by +3.5c at 24h (se 0.95; +2.1 at 30h, +2.2 at 18h, -0.6 at 12h; positive in 9 of 11 months and 10/10 cities at 24h) and ranks 2-6 are 1.4-2.5c overpriced; implied variance of the ladder is ~1.4x realized squared error. A taker pays spread+fee ~ the edge (+0.5c net at the ask), a maker pays no fee. Counterparty: retail spreading bets across neighbouring brackets. Wrong if fills are adversely selected (wx-maker bids on 5-50c brackets lost ~3c/ct) so the pooled CI of PnL per city-day is <= 0.
next: Parked: ad hoc 10-city Jan-Aug: favourite bid 26-40h +0.70c/ct (CI -1.18..+2.82), neighbour offers -1.11c/ct. Pipeline books source cannot hold multi-city months; revisit when it can.
